extraction.title: FEATURE: Can edit category/host relationships for embedding
extraction.head: rest-serializer-enhancement-post

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as moving embeddable hosts from site settings into an embeddable_hosts table linked to categories, with a new EmbeddableHost model, admin UI, REST serializer changes, and per-host category logic in TopicEmbed import. Confidence score of 1/5, citing a SQL injection in the migration and broken fabricators, specifically swapped content in category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb.
Style: the `|| []` fallback on the hydrated array may be unnecessary, since map() always returns an array. Suggested removing the fallback.
Syntax: typo in the describe block name, 'emeddable' should be 'embeddable'. Suggested a one-word fix.
Style: the explicit id, host, and category_id methods are redundant, since ActiveModel::Serializer generates attribute methods automatically. Suggested removing them unless custom logic is needed.
Logic: the edit action reads host.category.id without a guard, so it can throw if host.category is null or undefined. Suggested optional chaining.
Style: manually setting the category after save may cause sync problems. Suggested letting the server response update the category.
Logic: critical SQL injection risk, since the host value is interpolated directly into the INSERT statement. Suggested a parameterized query.

Logic: this change removes all category fabricators (:category, :diff_category, :happy_category, :private_category) and replaces them with an embeddable_host fabricator, which will break tests that rely on them.
Logic: critical error, since this file contains Category fabricators instead of EmbeddableHost fabricators. Suggested replacing the contents with embeddable_host fabricators.
Logic: calling sub! on a possibly nil host will raise NoMethodError. Suggested a presence check before the substitutions.

Logic: removing the blank check on the embeddable_hosts setting changes behavior. Embedding was previously blocked when no hosts were configured, and the bot asks whether that security posture is still intended.

additions.text: The pathFor method ignores its store, type, and findArgs parameters, which dynamic path generation typically needs. This could break CRUD operations that append IDs for individual resources.
deleteHost only removes the host from the local array. Persisted records should call host.destroyRecord() to delete them on the server.
The update method doesn't perform any updates. It just renders the same data as the show method.
When eh.try(:category_id) returns nil, it should fall back to SiteSetting.embed_category to maintain backward compatibility with existing configurations.
The custom id method is redundant, since the serializer already includes the id attribute from the object.
